description: A React component for a donation form with multiple payment options, state management, and UI rendering logic.

classes.name: DonateForm
classes.description: A React component class managing donation form UI and logic.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Resets donation state on component unmount.

methods.name: onDonationStateChange
methods.description: Updates donation form state and scrolls to top.

methods.name: handlePaymentButtonLoad

methods.description: Handles post-payment actions, including calling postCharge.

methods.name: resetDonation
methods.description: Resets donation form to default state.

methods.name: renderButtonGroup
methods.description: Renders payment method buttons and related UI.

methods.name: renderPageForm
methods.description: Renders the full donation page form.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method, displays success/error or donation form.
